_comment: DRAM Architecture Configuration for Hypothetical Scalability Studies
_description: Modify port bitwidths and other parameters to study 'what-if' scenarios

scalability_study.description: Hypothetical study: What if DDR4 had wider internal ports?
scalability_study._port_width_scale_comment: Multiply all port bitwidths by this factor. E.g., 4x makes 8-bit -> 32-bit
scalability_study._energy_scale_comment: Account for increased energy with wider ports. 1.5x = 50% more energy

custom_overrides._bank_port_comment: Override: What if banks had 32-bit ports instead of 8-bit?
custom_overrides._bank_group_comment: What if bank groups had 64-bit ports?
custom_overrides._clock_comment: What if we ran at DDR4-3200 speeds?

comparison_studies.name: DDR4 2x Wider Ports
comparison_studies.description: What if DDR4 had 16-bit bank ports instead of 8-bit?

comparison_studies.name: DDR4 4x Wider Ports
comparison_studies.description: What if DDR4 had 32-bit bank ports? (approaching HBM)

comparison_studies.name: DDR4 8x Wider Ports
comparison_studies.description: What if DDR4 had 64-bit bank ports? (HBM-like)

comparison_studies.name: HBM2 Baseline
comparison_studies.description: Real HBM2 with 64-bit bank ports via TSV

research_questions.question_1: At what port width does Bank-PIM become competitive with Rank-PIM?
research_questions.hypothesis_1: Need ~32-bit bank ports (4x DDR4 baseline) for Bank-PIM to match Rank-PIM
research_questions.question_2: How much energy overhead comes with wider internal ports?
research_questions.question_3: Can we achieve HBM-like PIM performance with modified DDR?
research_questions.hypothesis_3: Yes, if internal ports are widened to 32-64 bits, but requires architecture changes

validation_notes.note_1: DDR4 actual: 8-bit bank ports -> Rank-PIM optimal
validation_notes.note_2: HBM2 actual: 64-bit bank ports -> Bank-PIM viable
validation_notes.note_3: TSV in HBM enables wide internal paths without huge energy penalty
validation_notes.note_4: DDR wire routing limits practical internal port widths to 8-16 bits
